# The Wild West of Crypto: Chaos, Shenanigans, & The AI Revolution | The Friday Market Wrap!

First listed: 2025-09-26 | Evaluation cutoff: 2026-11-10

[Back to library](../README.md)

## Source versions

- [YouTube: The Wild West of Crypto: Chaos, Shenanigans, & The AI Revolution | The Friday Market Wrap!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQp2miSK1VI) - 2025-09-26
- [Substack: The Wild West of Crypto: Chaos, Shenanigans, & The AI Revolution | The Friday Market Wrap!](https://realeismanplaybook.substack.com/p/the-wild-west-of-crypto-chaos-shenanigans-4ac) - 2025-09-26

Earliest listed publication among matched versions, not proof of an unedited contemporaneous archive. Claim timestamps refer to the reviewed version.

## Summary

The September 26 wrap connects opaque crypto leverage with fragile market plumbing, maps the AI investment chain and focuses on funding risk behind giant cloud commitments. Eisman warns about vendor financing while explicitly declining to predict a recession.

The most useful contribution is following the funding chain from customers to suppliers, rather than accepting backlog as cash. Several supporting statements overreach: Binance publishes leverage limits, Nvidia announced a staged letter of intent, Mitsubishi competes in turbines, and solar incentives were curtailed rather than universally erased.

## Material claims

<a id="youtube-lQp2miSK1VI-c001"></a>
### 001. Opaque leverage and weak regulation can amplify financial-market instability, as in the historical crash analogy.

**Not testable** | Steve Eisman | analytical principle | major

[Source at 1:02-1:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQp2miSK1VI&t=62s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The analogy identifies a mechanism but does not establish a repetition of 1929 or a dated crash forecast.

Assessment test: Compare actual leverage, margin and liquidity structures rather than surface similarity.


<a id="youtube-lQp2miSK1VI-c002"></a>
### 002. Binance offers opaque high leverage without meaningful restrictions or publicly knowable limits.

**Mixed** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 1:59-4:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQp2miSK1VI&t=119s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

High leverage and liquidation mechanics are real, but Binance publishes brackets and account restrictions. Aggregate customer leverage may remain opaque, which is different from no rules.

Assessment test: Separate maximum permitted leverage from actual aggregate exposure.

- [Futures leverage and margin rules](https://www.binance.com/en/support/faq/detail/360033162192) (None): The exchange publishes leverage brackets, maintenance margins and liquidation rules, including dated 2025 account restrictions. High leverage is real, but a claim that no limits or public information exist is false.

<a id="youtube-lQp2miSK1VI-c003"></a>
### 003. Forced Ether liquidations on overseas exchanges caused the entire Monday crypto selloff.

**Unresolved** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 3:18-4:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQp2miSK1VI&t=198s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The narrative lacks inspected event-level positions and flows sufficient to attribute the whole move.

Assessment test: Reconstruct exchange liquidations, timing, depth and competing catalysts.


<a id="youtube-lQp2miSK1VI-c004"></a>
### 004. Intermediary and reserve-management risks can matter as much as the digital asset itself.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | analytical principle | major

[Source at 4:10-4:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQp2miSK1VI&t=250s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

Circle historical bank exposure and Tether reserve disclosures demonstrate distinct custody, liquidity and asset-composition risks.

Assessment test: Analyze the full issuer, exchange, custodian and redemption chain.

- [USDC reserve risk and de-peg](https://www.circle.com/pressroom/3-3-billion-of-usdc-reserve-risk-removed-dollar-de-peg-closes) (2023-03-13): Circle acknowledged a USDC de-peg during the SVB episode and a $3.3 billion bank deposit exposure. Pegs and short-duration reserves are not a guarantee of constant market prices.
- [Reserve assurance report](https://tether.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/ISAE_3000R_-_Opinion_TGRR_31.03.2025_RC187322025BD0035.pdf) (2025-05-01): The report is assurance on a specified reserves report under ISAE 3000, not a full financial-statement audit. Disclosed reserves include non-Treasury assets.

<a id="youtube-lQp2miSK1VI-c005"></a>
### 005. Tether non-Treasury assets create a potential stablecoin contagion risk.

**Unresolved** | Steve Eisman | forecast | major

[Source at 4:40-5:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQp2miSK1VI&t=280s) | Stance: conditional | Horizon: not stated

The assets exist, but a future de-peg and damage to Circle require a stress event. Calling Tether unregulated also overlooks its Salvadoran license.

Assessment test: Stress liquidity and capital against redemption scenarios.

- [Reserve assurance report](https://tether.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/ISAE_3000R_-_Opinion_TGRR_31.03.2025_RC187322025BD0035.pdf) (2025-05-01): The report is assurance on a specified reserves report under ISAE 3000, not a full financial-statement audit. Disclosed reserves include non-Treasury assets.
- [El Salvador issuer license](https://tether.io/news/tether-licensed-in-el-salvador-strengthening-focus-on-emerging-markets-and-innovation/) (2025-01-13): Tether announced a Salvadoran stablecoin-issuer and digital-asset-service license. Not being a US-regulated issuer is different from having no regulation.

<a id="youtube-lQp2miSK1VI-c006"></a>
### 006. Only stablecoins can achieve a meaningful role in global payments.

**Wrong** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 4:52-5:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQp2miSK1VI&t=292s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The categorical exclusion does not follow from volatility: conversion services can transfer other assets while quoting stable units. Commercial suitability remains a separate question.

Conditional reasoning: A volatile bridge asset can carry value between two stable-currency endpoints. Volatility imposes risk and cost but does not logically exclude meaningful payment use.

Assessment test: Distinguish the unit of account, transfer rail and final settlement asset.

**Not testable** | Steve Eisman | investment thesis | major

Assessment test: Specify breadth universe, calculation and forward-return test.

### 008. Technology leadership changes across successive investment waves, so current winners need not remain leaders.

<a id="youtube-lQp2miSK1VI-c009"></a>
### 009. Explosive token processing indicates growing demand for AI compute.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 9:35-10:21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQp2miSK1VI&t=575s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

Microsoft reported more than 100 trillion tokens, up fivefold, in fiscal Q3 2025. Token counts are not standardized measures of revenue, FLOPs or profitability across models.

Assessment test: Track unit costs, model mix and revenue per task as well as token volume.

- [Microsoft fiscal Q3 2025 earnings call](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/investor/events/fy-2025/earnings-fy-2025-q3) (2025-04-30): Microsoft reported processing more than 100 trillion tokens in the quarter, up fivefold. The figure was a usage measure, not an equal multiple of revenue or profit.

<a id="youtube-lQp2miSK1VI-c012"></a>
### 012. Solar and wind are no longer part of the near-term power story because their incentives were removed.

**Mixed** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 11:26-11:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQp2miSK1VI&t=686s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The policy accelerated deadlines and imposed conditions, but did not instantly eliminate every eligible project or all commercial demand. The broad exclusion is too categorical.

Assessment test: Inspect project start and in-service dates, credit rules and actual construction.

- [Clean electricity credits after the 2025 law](https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i7211) (None): Wind and solar termination rules include construction-start and placed-in-service exceptions. The final law is not identical to every June proposal and does not terminate every project credit on one date.

## Framework and tools

- Trace financing and counterparties behind growth.
- Inspect leverage and liquidation mechanisms.
- Map chips, networks, power, cooling and applications separately.
- Check thesis creep before reacting to recession fears.

Tools and charts discussed, not a complete visual inspection:

- Market breadth above the 50-day average
- Token usage
- RPO and customer concentration
- Capital-spending funding mix
- Monthly consumer securitization data
- Thesis checks

## Source cautions

Steve Eisman presents; speaker attribution follows the full dialogue.
- He explicitly says he does not currently expect recession.
- Reported Morgan Stanley spending forecasts are guest research, not an independently modeled Eisman forecast.
- Apple installed base refers to devices, not necessarily distinct people.
